appShell.title: Cycling Equipment Usage Tracker
appShell.importAttentionTooltip: Import needs attention — duplicate tours detected

errors.TYPE_MISMATCH: That component type does not fit this mount point.
errors.COMPONENT_RETIRED: This component is retired and can no longer be used.
errors.MOUNTING_OVERLAP: That change would overlap another mounting.
errors.IN_USE: This item is still in use elsewhere and cannot be deleted.
errors.ASSEMBLY_MEMBER_GUIDED_CHOICE: This component is part of an assembly. Mount the assembly, or remove it from the assembly first.
errors.ASSEMBLY_INCOMPLETE: This assembly has empty slots — fill every slot before mounting it.
errors.UNRESOLVED_SLOTS: Some slots need a mount point choice before this assembly can be mounted.
errors.SLOT_UNMOUNTABLE: One of this assembly's members can't be mounted at its resolved mount point.
errors.SLOT_TARGET_COLLISION: Two slots would resolve to the same mount point — choose different mount points.
errors.MEMBER_MOUNTED_ELSEWHERE: A member of this assembly is already mounted somewhere else.
errors.MOUNTING_GOVERNED: This mounting is managed by an assembly — mount/dismount the assembly to change it.
errors.ASSEMBLY_ALREADY_MOUNTED: This assembly is already mounted on a bike.
errors.BIKE_RETIRED: That bike is retired and can no longer receive mountings.
errors.ASSEMBLY_IN_USE: This assembly still has membership or mounting history and cannot be deleted.
errors.ASSEMBLY_SLOT_IN_USE: This slot still has membership history — end its validity instead of deleting it.
errors.ALREADY_MEMBER: This component already belongs to an assembly.
